Strings.squid.intro: Manage the Linux server HTTP/CONNECT gateway. Lists accept one entry per line. HTTPS is tunneled without decryption.
Strings.squid.remote_clients: Allow remote clients (restrict source networks first)
Strings.squid.networks: Allowed source networks (CIDR, one per line)
Strings.squid.allowed_domains: Allowed domains (empty allows any unblocked domain)
Strings.squid.upstream_host: HTTP parent host (empty for direct access)
Strings.squid.apply_message: This replaces the complete squid.conf and reloads Squid when running. Existing includes, authentication and cache rules are not merged. Confirm the preview and source networks before continuing. A stopped service stays stopped.
Strings.squid.close_message: Close Squid? Unsaved edits will be lost. Submitted server operations continue; retain the operation ID to check their result.
Strings.squid.reload_message: Load the saved configuration? Unsaved edits will be lost.
Strings.squid.pending: Result is unconfirmed. Resume with the same request key; do not create a duplicate operation.
Strings.squid.unsupported: Squid is supported only on a Linux System Mode server.
Strings.squid.install_required: Squid is not installed. Install the distribution Squid package on the server before applying configuration.
Strings.squid.recovery_required: An interrupted configuration transaction requires host recovery. Stop and disable remain available. See the Squid recovery procedure.
Strings.squid.status: Service: {0}; boot: {1}; desired revision: {2}; published: {3}; disk: {4}. This does not verify runtime adoption.
Strings.squid.preview_stale: Edits changed after this preview. Preview again before you rely on it.
Strings.squid.unavailable: Cannot confirm server state. Refresh to retry.
Strings.squid.read_only: Read-only access. Configuration changes require controller authorization.
Strings.squid.section.runtime_hint: Facts read from the server. They do not prove the runtime adopted the configuration.
Strings.squid.section.listener_hint: Every allow rule intersects the source networks, and the file always ends with http_access deny all.
Strings.squid.section.domains_hint: One entry per line; denied entries win over allowed entries.
Strings.squid.section.upstream_hint: Leave the host empty for direct access. A failing parent is never bypassed.
Strings.squid.section.adoption_hint: Applying replaces the whole squid.conf. Existing includes, authentication and cache rules are not merged.
Strings.squid.section.preview_hint: Preview renders the exact file. Native validation only parses it; neither publishes anything.
Strings.squid.adoption_required: No RelaxKonOS-managed squid.conf exists yet. Select ownership and apply a configuration before starting, restarting, reloading or enabling Squid.
Strings.squid.adopt_required: Select ownership to apply a configuration.
Strings.squid.apply_hint: Applying replaces the whole squid.conf; a stopped service stays stopped.
Strings.squid.activity.unconfirmed: Result still unconfirmed. Resume with the same request key.
Strings.squid.problem.listener.address.invalid: Enter a valid listen IP address.
Strings.squid.problem.listener.port.invalid: The listen port must be between 1024 and 65535.
Strings.squid.problem.listener.remote.opt_in_req: A non-loopback listen address also requires allowing remote clients.
Strings.squid.problem.networks.required_or_too_m: Provide at least one source network and no more than 128.
Strings.squid.problem.network.invalid_or_unrestr: Each source network must be a CIDR block with a prefix above 0.
Strings.squid.problem.domains.invalid_or_too_man: Provide no more than 256 domain entries.
Strings.squid.problem.domain.invalid: Invalid domain entry. Do not use wildcards, URLs, paths or IP addresses.
Strings.squid.problem.upstream.port.invalid_or_l: The parent port must be between 1 and 65535 and differ from the listen port.
Strings.squid.problem.upstream.host.invalid: The parent host must be a valid domain name or IP address.
Strings.application.relaxkonos.squid.description: Manage the Linux server HTTP/CONNECT gateway. Lists accept one entry per line. HTTPS is tunneled without decryption.
Strings.squid.runtime_note: File matching does not verify runtime adoption or HTTP/CONNECT availability.
